notes.subject: חסר לב
notes.rationale: 'o senngwe ke pelo' (lacking heart) kgahlanong le 'o sena bohlale' — KJV/JPS bolella 'lacking understanding/wisdom', YLT/JPS e dula haufi le lentsoe-sejwale 'lacking heart'

notes.subject: o senngwe ke pelo
notes.rationale: Seheberu se re 'חסר לב' — ya senang pelo; 'pelo' ke lehlakore la Seheberu la maikutlo le bohlale, eseng thupelo feela

notes.subject: בז / חסר
notes.rationale: Khutliso ya mafoko makhutshwane a mabedi a nang le menyetla e mmedi (buz/khasar) — sa tswelwa ka Sesotho

translation: Ya nyatsa mogwake wa hae o senngwe ke pelo; empa mona wa kutlwisiso o ile a thoma.
